chunks: And from a letter of his (peace be upon him) to the officers through whose jurisdiction the army passed.
ai.seo_question: Who was the recipient of Imam Ali's letter regarding the army's passage?
ai.summary: This heading introduces a directive from Imam Ali (AS) to the provincial governors (Wulat) responsible for the logistical support of the army during its campaigns, particularly the Battle of Siffin. It highlights the administrative burden placed on local officials to provide provisions and safe passage, reflecting the Caliphate's reliance on a coordinated civil-military infrastructure. The phrase sets the stage for instructions on fair treatment of soldiers and efficient resource management, underscoring the principle of shared responsibility in governance.
